update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.58 - Champions Meeting weighting, max race distance cap, 4-in-a-row race penalty, epithet progress
New --- - Smart Race Solver: added an optional Champions Meeting (CM1-CM17) calendar preset that scores races higher when they match the upcoming CM's distance/surface/handedness/season profile, nudging the schedule toward useful prep races. The calendar is ported from a community Trackblazer scheduler reference and has not been independently re-verified against uma.guide/GameTora. - Smart Race Solver: added a Max Race Distance setting that hard-caps how far a race's distance can be, so the solver won't pick distance outliers just to chase an epithet. - Smart Race Solver: added a separate Four-in-a-Row Penalty that stacks on top of the existing 3+ consecutive-race penalty once a race turn is the 4th or later in an unbroken chain. - Smart Race Solver settings now show "(current/required)" progress counters on each target epithet chip, based on the projected schedule.
